name: Star-Crosst
source:
War is rough. Rebuilding isn’t easy. But we all start somewhere.

The year is 2323. Thirteen years ago, the Earth was attacked by an invasive alien species. They used a superweapon that altered the Earth’s atmosphere, causing intense weather changes in the space of hours, creating hurricanes in jungles and blizzards in deserts. They made no attempts to communicate. Humans had taken to calling them ‘riklid.’

And today, the humans won. The riklid retreat after being dealt a decisive blow.

You play as Ezra Foy, a young twenty-something coming out of their senior year at university. For Ezra, it feels like time had stopped: the war effort was all anyone could focus on, and now that peace has finally been won again, the time for revelry and relationships has begun. Choose between three love interests, each with their own deep branching storylines and hundreds of lines of dialogue; enjoy a futuristic setting involving people and places of all different walks of life, including a friendly lizard-like alien species known as the Ghians; and decide what the best course of action should be living in a post-war era, and what we as individuals can do for our future.

(from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2206870/StarCrosst/]Steam[/url])
translation:
战争是残酷的。重建并不容易。但我们都从某个地方开始。

公元2323年，十三年前，地球遭到外星入侵物种的袭击。他们使用一种超级武器改变了地球的大气层，在数小时内造成剧烈的天气变化，在丛林中制造飓风，在沙漠中制造暴风雪。他们没有尝试沟通。人类开始称它们为“riklid”。

而今天，人类赢了。里克利德人受到决定性的打击后撤退。

你扮演埃兹拉·福伊 (Ezra Foy)，一名刚从大学四年级毕业的二十多岁的年轻人。对于以斯拉来说，感觉时间已经停止了：战争是每个人都可以关注的事情，现在和平终于再次赢得，狂欢和关系的时间已经开始。在三种爱情兴趣之间进行选择，每种兴趣都有自己深刻的分支故事情节和数百行对话；享受未来主义的环境，涉及各行各业的人和地方，包括一种友好的蜥蜴般的外来物种，称为吉安人；并决定战后时代的最佳行动方针是什么，以及我们作为个人可以为我们的未来做些什么。

（来自 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2206870/StarCrosst/]Steam[/url]）
